verdict.rationale: Customer verification is a fair axis for an embedded-banking product, but the evidence pack never documents KYC/KYB APIs, document collection, watchlist screening, or modeled application states. The only nearby material is a fraud-guide line telling platforms to build and operate their own onboarding controls. That is an adjacent, platform-side responsibility, not a product verification capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, customer verification is programmatic — KYC for individuals and KYB for businesses with document collection, watchlist screening, and clearly modeled application states
